name: O mistério da família Adelais
source:
Alice expected nothing more than keepsakes and a cat. Instead, her inheritance begins to twist reality around her. 

What secret did her grandmother leave behind?

[From [url=https://elainellowe.itch.io/o-mistrio-da-famlia-adelais]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
爱丽丝只想要纪念品和一只猫。相反，她的继承开始扭曲她周围的现实。

她的祖母留下了什么秘密？

[来自[url=https://elainellowe.itch.io/o-mistrio-da-famlia-adelais]Itch.io[/url]]
